title: Kusoma kwa Kina (Theme 6: Usalama barabarani)
status: draft: written 18 Nov 2026 offline for Grade 9 Kiswahili; not yet checked by a native Kiswahili teacher; not loaded by the live tutor

skills.key_step: The child explains maudhui and dhamira, finds them in a poem with a line as evidence, and explains a word of the poem from its line.

floor.prerequisite: Reads a poem for its message.
floor.question: Ujumbe wa shairi ni upi?

representations: a road-safety poem with lines numbered

board.do: Dereva punguza mwendo, uhai si mchezo

board.say: Suala ni lipi na lengo ni lipi?

board.do: Wait for the child to answer before saying anything.
The child fills the chart with a line for each.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni jibu lipi linalopatana na matini?" Kwa nini "jibu lisilopatana na matini" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu lazima lijibu swali lote, si jambo moja dogo.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni jibu lipi linalopatana na matini?" Kwa nini "jibu lisilopatana na matini" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu lazima lipatane na matini, si kinyume chake.

misconceptions.ask: Soma tena: "Ni jibu lipi linalopatana na matini?" Kwa nini "jibu lisilopatana na matini" si jibu sahihi?
misconceptions.repair: Jibu lazima lipatikane kwenye matini, si kuongezwa kutoka nje.

misconceptions.ask: Ni suala au ni lengo la mshairi?
misconceptions.repair: Dhamira ni lengo la mshairi; maudhui ni suala linalozungumziwa.

checks.question: Dhamira ya shairi la usalama barabarani inaweza kuwa?
checks.answer: kuwahimiza watumiaji wa barabara kuwa waangalifu
